mentions.name: Inversion Works
mentions.description: An app-only lunch bowl chain that handles very complex food customisation without breaking. It uses 'cook augmentation' to take over kitchen decision-making and QA, and offers app-only ordering that is accessible to AI agents, so customers can simply tell their agent "I'm hungry" and receive a fresh, hot bowl. Currently at prototype stage, raising an angel round to run a live pop-up.
mentions.audience: People ordering meals through conversational AI agents; consumer food service
mentions.source_excerpt:
An app-only lunch bowl chain that can execute very complex customisation without breaking. We've built "cook augmentation" that takes over decision making and QA, added an app-only ordering (accessible to the agents) and ended up with a frictionless experience where you just tell your agent "I'm hungry" and we cook a fresh, hot, delicious bowl that's good for you.

Currently at prototype stage, raising angel round in order to do a live pop-up.
mentions.author: IliaLitviak
